The Steamworks is a large structure built on the precipice between eastern Hotland and the northeastern Dunes, connecting both areas. In general, the Dunes seem to be located deeper than Hotland.

The Dunes, much like Hotland, are a scorched and arid region. Unlike Hotland, in which heat comes from an abundance of exposed magma in the area, the Dunes are arid due to a large amount of Swelterstones that can be found there, producing heat and light. A massive Swelterstone also functions as a sort of sun in the area, and can be clearly seen from the mountaintop.

The Dunes are rich in minerals and other important materials. As such, the East Mines is set up in the Dunes, operated by Mining Co. Besides all the mining activity, the Dunes have two known monster settlements: Oasis Valley located somewhat centrally, and the Wild East, located at the eastern end of the area, close to the Steamworks.

entries.name: Oasis Valley
entries.content: The Oasis Valley is a small secondary town located in the dunes and as its name indicates it is built in an oasis, with it having a small pool of water in the middle surrounded by palm trees.

entries.name: Wild East
entries.content: The Wild East is the town at the end of the Dunes. The town is very reminiscent of the wild west, given that the Sheriff governing this town, North Star, also known as Starlo has found human movies that take place in that period. He and the rest of the Feisty Four run the town with the aim of entertaining the residents (though sometimes, they end up annoying them instead).

entries.name: The Steamworks
entries.content:
The Steamworks are a decommissioned factory that predates the CORE. When the Steamworks were operational, they fulfilled a very similar function to the CORE, being the primary source of power for the Underground. The Steamworks is a large complex located between the Dunes and Hotland, being connected to Sunnyside Farm in the northeastern Dunes on one end, as well as being just an elevator ride away from Hotland's UG Apartments on the other end.

The remaining inhabitants of the Steamworks are all old and usually defective robots.

entries.name: New Home
entries.content:
New Home is the new capital of the Underground, ruled by Asgore Dreemurr.

New Home is an entirely gray setting, occupied by long corridors and what appears to be a large city in the background. It does, however, contain the Throne Room and the Last Corridor, both of which are well-lit, brightly colored rooms, primarily sunlight-yellow.

entries.name: Annoying Dog
entries.content:
The Annoying Dog is a small, white, smiling dog. The Annoying Dog shows up periodically at random, most often around Papyrus. Whenever it shows up, it often somehow comedically ruins plans people make regardless of who they are.

Unbeknownst to all, this seemingly unsuspecting dog is god in its truest form. It can talk, but it chooses not to and prefers to bark and act like a dog.

entries.name: Greater Dog
entries.content:
Greater Dog is a guard dog and is a member of the Royal Guard.

Greater Dog's fur is wholly white, and it wears mantle-gray armor adorned at the wrists with apparently functional dog faces, much like the spear weapon it holds during battle. However, Greater Dog itself only fills the smallest neck portion and the tail area of the armor while controlling the rest of the suit through unknown means. Notably, when it jumps out of the suit, its "hands" seem to withdraw into the armor and don't reappear when it hops back in backwards.

Greater Dog is incredibly affectionate and constantly seeks attention.

entries.name: Lesser Dog
entries.content:
Lesser Dog is a member of the Royal Guard.

Lesser Dog's fur is a light cream color, and its red tongue appears to be perpetually lolling out of its mouth. It wears gray, presumably metal armor with a darker gray band around the waist area. It holds a sword and a shield with the Delta Rune.

Like several other dog characters, Lesser Dog becomes overexcited from physical attention. It is capable of extending its neck at a seemingly limitless rate when stimulated by being pet.

Lesser Dog appears to enjoy spending its time off sentry duty by playing card games (namely, poker and go fish) against itself at Grillby's.

entries.name: Doggo
entries.content:
Doggo is a member of the Royal Guard as a sentry. He appears to be a bipedal dog monster. He wears a cotton-candy-pink muscle shirt with a picture of a dog on the front, a ninja-like mask, and leopard-print stretch pants. He also has a brown belt, and white tail. His lower paws appear to be bare. He dual wields short swords similar to the typical King playing card.

Doggo's most notable feature is his inability to see stationary objects; he can only sense things that are moving, and he dislikes things and people that appear or transport themselves without physically moving (such as Sans). He seems to be occasionally unsure of himself and, if he sees something, checks to see if it moves again.

His hobbies include "squirrels," which refers to a common dog's habit of chasing squirrels. Doggo smokes dog-treats similar to the conventional cigarette.

entries.name: Temmie
entries.content:
Tommie is a species of monster in the Underground.

Temmies resemble dogs, with cat-like ears on top of their heads as well as dog ears on the sides, shoulder length black hair, and blue shirts, excluding the Temmie Shopkeeper, who has gray hair and a striped blue and yellow shirt instead.

All Temmies share an erratic manner of speech, where they often exclude letters, mix lower and upper cases, make inconsistencies, etc. There are some exceptions, however; such as when denied something they want like Temmie Flakes.

They find Humans cute but muscles disgusting.

entries.name: Temmie Village
entries.content:
Temmie Village is a small, elusive region within Waterfall that is comprised of two rooms. The village is home to many Temmies, notable for their quirkiness and broken English, and the Tem Shop.

Temmie Village is said to have a very deep history though it is never explained.

Temmie Village has the same overall visual theme as the rest of Waterfall: a dark cavern with purple tones. It has a cheery musical theme, and several Temmies, Bob, and Ragel the mushroom populate it. The village also has a statue of "Tem", and a vendor inside of the Tem Shop.

entries.name: Bisicle
entries.content: It's a two-pronged popsicle, so you can eat it twice.

entries.name: Burgerpants
entries.content:
"Burgerpants" is an employee at the MTT-Brand Burger Emporium, a fast-food restaurant located inside the MTT Resort.

Burgerpants is a 19-year-old orange cat-like monster who wears a small hat with the letter M on it, as a part of his unfortunate dead-end job working for the MTT-Brand Burger Emporium.

Burgerpants is a highly stressed-out service employee, who hates his job and his employer. He mentions that he originally wanted to be an actor when talking to him, which is likely the reason he makes many dramatic facial expressions. He can be sarcastic at times, as shown when he is annoyed. He maintains a cynical view of the world and his future, specifically about his interactions with attractive people. Despite this, he is still shown to be rather hopeful at times. He can be ecstatic and very opinionated when talking about certain topics.

entries.name: Bratty & Catty
entries.content:
Bratty and Catty are a pair of vendors that can be found in an alley to the right of the MTT Resort. They are best friends, often saying the same lines or finishing sentences for each other (usually in the American valley-girl dialect), and both are big fans of Mettaton.

Bratty is a tall, green alligator monster that wears a primarily pink shawl with yellow and blue details on the sides. She has yellow hair that flows into curls.

Catty is a plump purple cat creature who wears a set of blue overalls with yellow buttons and tufts of yellow hair coming out from under it on either side. She has black hair with blue and lavender tips, and a yellow earring on her left ear.

entries.name: Garbage Dump
entries.content: The Garbage Dump is a region at the low point of Waterfall, where garbage from both the Underground and the Surface accumulates.

entries.name: Grillby
entries.content:
Grillby is a fire monster, and owner and proprietor of Grillby's. He wears glasses and a black, long-sleeved suit with a white collar, a gray bow-tie, and black buttons. While generally very quiet, he very occasionally ever speak. Due to his physiology, he has a fear of water.

Grillby used to live in Hotland, but moved to Snowdin because he prefers the cold (ironically, for a fire elemental). He heats drinks by hand.

entries.name: Gerson
entries.content:
An elderly looking olive green tortoise-monster, Gerson wears archeologist attire, with a pointed beard, a large magnifying glass, and a tan pith helmet. His teeth are crooked and yellow and his shell is a dark brown color with a pale cream rim. He also seems to be unable to open his right eye.

Due to living for a long period of time compared to other monsters and from studying history, Gerson has gained many knowledgeable insights about the history of monsters in the Underground, including the Delta Rune prophecy. Despite this, he seems to have trouble remembering certain information such as the location of Temmie Village and why Asgore was nicknamed "Fluffybuns." He was alive when Toriel also ruled the Underground with Asgore and while stating that it was tragic that she left, there was a bit of relief due to them being open to their affection to one another.

He was also known to be hero in his youth, with his nickname being "The Hammer of Justice." Undyne was known to look up at him when she was young and still respects him as she grows up. Gerson appreciates her willingness to join him in his youth despite some of the trouble she caused back then.

entries.name: EXP
entries.content: What's EXP is an acronym for "execution points." A way of quantifying the pain you have inflicted on others. When you kill someone, your EXP increases. EXP is gained by killing monsters. When the enough EXP is accumulated, their LV increases.

entries.name: Underground
entries.content:
The Underground is a large region within Mount Ebott that is separated from the Surface of the Earth. It houses the kingdom of Monsters, who are ruled by King Asgore, and formerly by his ex-wife, Toriel. The Underground has varying terrain and climates, and features five main areas: the Ruins, the frigid and wintery Snowdin, the marshy and cavernous Waterfall, the blistery and barren Hotland, and the Capital. The Underground's exit is blocked by the Barrier, which was placed by the Humans long ago. Anything and anyone can enter the Underground by descending into Mount Ebott.

After the Humans defeated the Monsters in The War, the losing faction was banished into the Underground. A Barrier was erected to prevent the insiders from leaving, though outsiders could still freely enter. Wary of humans, monsters retreated into the Ruins and adapted Home as their first capital, living normal lives in the Underground from then on. Additionally, the Ruins was structured to contain diversions in the form of puzzles.

One day, the first human ascended Mt. Ebott and tripped on a vine, causing them to fall inside and enter the Underground. The human was discovered by Asriel Dreemurr, the son of Asgore and Toriel, and was adopted into their family. Chara's presence brought hope to monsters. Eventually, no longer fearing humans, monsters ventured outside of the Ruins, populated the rest of the Underground, and made New Home their new capital.

In contrast to Home, some monsters were content to settle at different locations than in New Home. From Waterfall, monsters acquired modern technology and discarded items from the Surface. At some point, the CORE was created by W. D. Gaster to convert electric power for the entirety of the Underground. Snowdin's blocks of ice is utilized to help keep the CORE from overheating.

However, one day, the Chara grew ill and requested to see the flowers in their home village. After they died, Asriel absorbed their SOUL and became a powerful entity that was able to cross the Barrier. He carried their corpse to the center of the human's village, which had a patch of Golden Flowers. The humans attacked Asriel, under the assumption that he had killed the human child. Refusing to retaliate, he returned to the Underground with Chara's corpse and died in New Home's garden where he succumbed to his wounds.

Since then, Asgore became vengeful for his son and plotted to escape the Underground and declare another war against humans. He declared all humans who fall into the Underground be killed and their SOULs collected; with seven human SOULs, the Barrier could be shattered. However, the brutality of this decision disgusted Toriel enough that she relinquished her position as queen as well as her marriage to Asgore.

Asgore continued to rule the land on his own while Toriel exiled herself into the Ruins. Over time, six more humans fell into the Underground, all of which Toriel tried to shelter and care for. However, they all eventually left the Ruins and were eventually killed, their SOULs collected by Asgore.

entries.name: Grillby's
entries.content: Grillby's is a pub with a cozy atmosphere located in Snowdin. It is named after and run by Grillby, a monster made entirely of fire. Asides from a variety of drinks, this establishment only serves burgers and fries as food.

entries.name: Onionsan
entries.content:
Onionsan is a large aquatic monster that lives in Waterfall. They make faces that look animesque and have a rounded upper body that resembles an onion. They also follow the protagonist throughout their room to keep up a conversation.

Onionsan claims that Waterfall is their "Big Favorite," although they express concern about the water getting very shallow as of late. Onionsan is also very lonely, as shown by their desperation to engage in conversation. They explain that all their friends moved to a crowded aquarium in the city, saying that they cannot join them because the aquarium is full. Despite this, Onionsan tries to maintain a positive outlook, saying that Undyne will fix everything and that someday they will get out and live in the ocean.

Onionsan plans on starting a band called the "Red Hot Chibi Peppers" despite it not knowing how to sing or play instruments.

entries.name: River Person
entries.content:
The River Person is a hooded figure who provides transportation services to Snowdin, Waterfall, and Hotland on their wooden boat for the Underground. You can request a ride to any of the locations above.

During the trip, the River Person has a list of messages they can say at random, often being a hint to a secret or an allusion to something, or just something cute.

entries.name: Echo Flower
entries.content:
Echo Flowers are a type of flora found in Waterfall. They are named after their ability to repeat the last sounds they have been exposed to, similar to echoes. Eventually, the sounds they emit become white noise.

Like most flora in Waterfall, Echo Flowers are blue and bio-luminescent. They have a large corolla with six lighter colored petals. Echo Flower plants have one tall stem, where an individual blossom grows.

entries.name: Librarby
entries.content: The Snowdin Library, misspelled as "LIBRARBY" on the sign, is a library near the middle of Snowdin. The library is aware of this mistake and has not made any effort of fixing it.

entries.name: Golden Flower
entries.content:
Golden Flowers have corollas with five to six yellow petals. They grow on individual stems and appear to grow in patches as well. Golden Flowers originated from the Surface, and can easily adapt to new environments.

Their sticky seeds helped them to be brought to and spread throughout the Underground. They can be used to make tea.

entries.name: Royal Guard
entries.content:
The Royal Guard are a group of monsters dedicated to defending the Underground, protecting Asgore, and searching for a human to acquire the last of the 7 SOULs.

They are supposedly an "elite" group of guards, but many of their members appear laughably incompetent. Undyne, the leader of the Royal Guard, decides who becomes a member. Papyrus's dream is to become a famous member of the Royal Guard, but despite his surprisingly adept combat ability, Undyne secretly does not let him join as he is too kind and friendly, believing these attributes may get him killed in battle.

entries.name: Temmie Flake
entries.content: Temmie Flakes are torn up pieces of colored construction paper sold at the Tem Shop. Temmie Flakes are somehow the main source of food for Temmies despite the flakes being torn colored pieces of paper.

entries.name: Boss Monster
entries.content:
A Boss Monster is a special species of monster who distinctly has SOUL persistence. Known Boss Monsters rule over the Underground.

Mature Boss Monsters only age when their offspring does. This explains Asgore and Toriel's longevity as their son, Asriel, died at one point, and they therefore cannot biologically age.

When a Boss Monster dies, their body turns to dust; however, their SOUL, in an upside down heart shape, lingers for a few seconds before shattering. Similar to other monsters' SOULs, the SOULs of Boss Monsters are white.

entries.name: Delta Rune
entries.content:
The Delta Rune is an emblem representing the Kingdom of Monsters. It is an orb between two wings and three triangles beneath it, with the middle triangle inverted.

The emblem or portions of it are depicted in various areas, armor, and occasionally, monsters visually resemble it.

The Delta Rune is said to predate written history. However, the original meaning has been lost in time. What is certain is the bottom triangles symbolize the monsters of the Underground. The winged circle is believed to represent the "angel," which is prophesized to be the one that has seen the Surface and will return one day to depopulate the underground.

This prophecy has two interpretations: one where the "angel" destroys the barrier and brings freedom to the monsters, and a more recent outlook on it, where it is an "Angel of Death" that kills everyone in the Underground, thus "freeing" them from the mortal realm.

entries.name: Home
entries.content: Home is the first city of monsters founded in the Underground after the war ended and monsters were trapped behind the barrier. Home was later abandoned when monsters moved into New Home.

entries.name: CORE
entries.content: The CORE is a sub section of Hotland, accessible from the MTT Resort. It is a technologically advanced facility that provides magical electricity to the Underground. There is an elevator to New Home in the center of the CORE. The entire structure is designed so that the rooms inside can change positions and the layout can be altered.

entries.name: East Mines
entries.content: The East Mines is a mine owned by Mining Co. It is located inside of the Dunes.

entries.name: UnderNet
entries.content: UnderNet is "the Underground's number one social network," according to Alphys.

entries.name: Monster Kidz Word Search
entries.content: The Monster Kidz Word Search is an unsolvable word search puzzle. The word search contains a bear-faced ice cube named "Ice-E." The word "giasfclfebrehber" is not present in the word search, as the top line reads "giasfclfubrehber."

entries.name: Blackjack
entries.content:
Blackjack is a man with bright purple skin with a large, gray handlebar mustache, wearing a desaturated dark blue hat and wearing round glasses. As for clothes, he wears a black vest, a dark purple bowtie, desaturated dark blue pants, and a black shoe. He seems to be obese and is missing his right leg, which is replaced by a wooden one.

Blackjack is your typical western blacksmith, selling items like Gunpowder and Revolvers. He's upbeat and slightly eccentric, willing to sell anything to and take anything off Clover's hands. Notably, he despises the Feisty Four, calling them "five demonic youngsters," before immediately calling other residents delightful.

He can be extremely reckless sometimes, accidentally firing off his revolver unintentionally at times.

He can also come off morally ambiguous, stating that he's not a fan of violence himself, and to not further question his morality. Furthermore, he states that he makes sure that his wares aren't lethal, but they could be since even everyday items could be lethal as well.

He's also a hypocrite.

entries.name: Dina
entries.content:
Dina is a woman with tan skin and reddish-purple hair. She most resembles an armadillo with her chestplate and ears. Instead of a traditional scarf, she has multiple real snakes (not monsters) wrapped around her neck that wiggle around aimlessly.

Much like the other residents of the Wild East, Dina has the demeanor of a stereotypical Western character, frequently saying howdy among other things. She's also far more relaxed than many other characters, not holding any ill will towards humans. Like most other vendors, she gets slightly annoyed when people attempt to sell items to her, helpfully informing them that Blackjack might buy the items instead.

She seems to have a soft spot for animals, adopting snakes named Ann, Sammy and Bert that she says she found in crevasses in the Dunes. She mostly has them to keep her company while business is slow in the saloon. Despite other monsters thinking it's weird to keep pets, she instead finds it to be cute.

entries.name: Mo
entries.content:
Mo is a raccoon-looking salesman from Snowdin. He can be seen in Snowdin, Dunes and Steamworks, selling items.

Mo is dressed in a professional blue suit, complemented by a tasteful pink tie. He completes his outfit with a matching fedora, which features a band in a slightly darker shade of blue, coordinated with his suit. Additionally, he accessorizes with a pair of sunglasses that obscure his eyes.

Mo is highly motivated by financial success and possesses strong persuasion skills. Furthermore, he maintains a polished yet direct approach in his interactions.

entries.name: Feisty Four
entries.content: The Feisty Four are a gang who rules the town of the Wild East. Alongside their leader, North Star, they form the Feisty Five (Fearlessness, Excellence, Intuition, Sneakiness, Toughness, Youthfulness, and Justice. The J is silent.) Gang members, aside from North Star, are Ed, Moray, Ace and Mooch.

entries.name: Ed
entries.content:
Ed is a large, pink ogre-like monster. He has a circular body and wears a fancy tuxedo-esque outfit, with the shirt being sleeveless. His face has large bushy eyebrows, as well as a single square tooth sticking out his mouth upwards.

Ed is a fearless and tough monster. He is also the most temperamental one in the posse, but he recognizes it and states that he wants to work on it. In addition, he wants to learn how to play the guitar, but due to him being bigger than the others, he can not play it.

entries.name: Moray
entries.content:
Moray is a blue, humanoid monster with fish elements. They wear a beret and musketeer-like armor. Additionally, their eyes are covered up by their hair, which itself appears to sweep to the side.

Moray represents the E and Y in Feisty, being Excellence and Youthfulness respectively. They are the only member of the four (without counting their boss) that is known to keep contact with their parents. Moray is also more caring and sympathetic towards Martlet, as they bring her food even though it is not mealtime. They are also the one that stays more in-character when the posse are acting for a mission for Clover in comparison to some of the other members.

entries.name: Ace
entries.content:
Ace is a grey humanoid monster, donning a fancy tuxedo and a top hat. His facial features are obscured by a shadow being casted from his top hat that covers a majority of his face, with the exception of his left eye.

Ace is the most serious member of the posse. Due to this, he is seen reacting to the other three shenanigans with face palms. But this does not mean that he joins as well at some of the adventures of the Feisty Four. As Blackjack states that he and Mooch installed the speaker system throughout the town, using it to play an eagle screech and play jingles and songs. Ace is also the one that represents the I in feisty, this letter representing intuition. He also describes himself as "2D as my cards" but doesn’t seem to be bothered by that. Moreover, he notices smaller details.

entries.name: Mooch
entries.content:
Mooch is a grey squirrel monster with purple hair. She wears a large green hat with holes for her ears to pop out of, as well as a green jacket with a purple shirt. She also wears no shoes and has 3 toes. Additionally, she wears a green scarf that slightly obscures her mouth.

Mooch is the only one in the group that commits crimes, this being pickpocketing and thievery. She is sneaky and is the representative of the S in Feisty, which stands for Sneakiness. As Ace stated, she is the only one that never oversteps her boundaries. Mooch sometimes makes sarcastic remarks, since she tells Ace to not be so kind when he doesn’t even ask for her help in battle. Despite this, Mooch can be kind when she wants to be. Mooch is the youngest member of the posse, since Dina doesn’t let her sneak a drink. 

She likes shiny items.

entries.name: Underground Postal Service
entries.content: The Underground Postal Service (UGPS) is the Underground's Postal Service. It is in charge of both delivering Mail and Fast Travel.

entries.name: Mail Whale
entries.content:
Mail Whale is a monster resembling a pink whale with a white underbelly and small wings. It wears a blue mailman cap on its head and a bag on its flipper.

When someone interacts with a UGPS station, Mail Whale descends from above and gives them mail (provided they have any to offer) or provide travel to wherever that person needs to go to.

entries.name: Honeydew Resort
entries.content: The Honeydew Resort is a resort found within the region of Snowdin. It is a resort owned by the family of the Honeydew Shopkeeper.

entries.name: Alphy's Lab
entries.content:
The Royal Laboratory is the workplace and home of the Royal Scientist, Alphys, in Hotland. It is a single building where Alphys conducts her studies, controls sections of Hotland's puzzles, and surveys the majority of the Underground through hidden cameras. It also houses the True Lab.

The Lab is a large white and red building with a pale green interior. There are two floors on the lab, the ground floor being Alphys's workplace, and the second floor being her room. Three conveyor belts are also in the Lab, with two leading to the other floor, and one on second floor that moves to the left.

On the ground floor, there is a console with a large monitor, a "cute" garbage can, a messy computer desk with papers and bowls, a fridge filled with Instant Noodles and soda, a bag of dog food, and the elevator, which has a bathroom sign beside the door.

entries.name: Void
entries.content: The Void is a grey, empty region beyond space and time where the timeline can be observed.

entries.name: Grey Door
entries.content: A mysterious grey door that will very, very rarely ever appear embedded on the rocky wall of Waterfall. This door leads to an area known as the Void, where the previous Royal Scientist, W. D. Gaster (or what remnant is left of him), is trapped in after falling into the CORE and being erased from existence.

entries.name: Gaster Blaster
entries.content: Gaster Blasters are levitating skeletal dragon heads which can fire lasers. Only skeletal monsters like Sans, Papyrus, and Gaster are able to summon and use these.

entries.name: Throne Room
entries.content: The Throne Room is a large and open room with birds chirping in the background. Light shines from above, casting an irregular pattern of light and shadow on the floor. In the middle of the room is a throne, assumed to be Asgore's, and cast off to the side is another throne covered by a white sheet, assumed to be Toriel's. Inside of the Throne Room is Asgore, who is usually always there as to water the golden flowers. When passing the Throne Room, another small area is located, in which right after the small area, is the never ending barrier.

entries.name: Fallen Down
entries.content: The term "fallen down", in regards of monsters, refers to a state where a monster enters comatose and becomes immobile, dying shortly afterwards. When a monster dies, their body turns into dust. This state usually occurs when a monster becomes too old, but can also occur through other causes asides from being killed. This can be temporarily prevented with Determination, but that'll only delay the inevitable and potentially make things worse than it already is.

entries.name: Snowdin Canine Unit
entries.content:
The Snowdin Canine Unit (SCU) is the only special division of the Royal Guard. As the name implies, they are anthropomorphic, white furred dog monsters who are stationed at Snowdin being on the lookout for humans who comes by. However being dogs, they can be easily capable of being swayed or distracted as any dog would. Members of this division are Doggo, Lesser Dog, Greater Dog, Dogamy, and Dogaressa.   

Off duty or on their break, they regularly come together and have a seat at Grillby's.

entries.name: Dogamy & Dogaressa
entries.content:
Dogamy and Dogaressa, collectively referred to as "Dogi", are members of the Royal Guard.

They are near identical in appearance, both having round snouts, floppy ears, and muscular builds covered by dark hooded robes with the face of their spouse printed on the front. Their main differences in appearance being Dogamy's thick lowered brow, cowlick and pseudo-mustache, and Dogaressa's emphasized eyelashes. In battle, they both wield long battleaxes, with eyes that show features imitating those of their owners.

They primarily use their sense of smell to detect others, but not much else, implying their eyesight is inferior, much like Doggo, who either of them may be biologically related to. Despite this, they love each other dearly, and this is shown in their attacks in battle, using heart-shaped attacks and coordinating their axe strikes.

The couple came #2 in the "Nose Nuzzle Championship '98," having lost the number one position to Toriel and Asgore.

entries.name: Nose Nuzzle Championship
entries.content: Nose Nuzzle Championship is an annual contest to see which contesting couple can do their best nose nuzzle. The couple that wins first place gets a trophy. This contest is a key element of Monster tradition, which is why it's done yearly.

entries.name: El Bailador
entries.content:
El Bailador is a muscular, humanoid monster standing at twice Clover's height. He has red skin with yellow triangular markings running across his collarbone. He has white eyes, a blond feathery mohawk, broad shoulders, and well-defined abs. His mouth is triangular in shape, but forms a 'W' shape when smiling.

He wears a costume reminiscent of a luchador (Mexican wrestler), consisting of long yellow gloves, dark red trunks fastened by a gold belt endorning a rhombus-shaped buckle, and gold knee-length leg armor. His long orange cape with yellow trimming has a lining colored in three vertical strips from left to right: blue, green and red, the reverse order of the dancemat he presents the player. His face appears to be covered by an orange luchador mask with orange eyepieces resembling long lashes. This apparent mask does not seem to cover his mouth, as it visibly moves when he speaks.

El Bailador greatly enjoys dancing and longs to share his passion with others. He despises solitude and quietness, and uses dance to distract himself from the dire situation of being trapped below the surface. He also wants to cheer the other monsters up and bring joy to the Underground.

Beneath his outgoing, flamboyant demeanor, however, lies a more delicate side. He gets very upset if you do not share his appreciation for dance.

entries.name: Sunnyside Farm
entries.content: Sunnyside Farm is the name of Starlo's family run corn farm, which he runs along the side of being the Sheriff of the Wild East. Given that he and his family has a surplus of corn at his disposal, he often gives a hefty amount of it to Ceroba at no charge.
